response: Folks, let’s talk about some genuine common sense and respect for the rule of law happening out in South Dakota this Thursday, courtesy of Governor Larry Rhoden signing Senate Bill 175 into law. It is just basic decency that anyone wanting to participate in our elections should have to prove they are actually United States citizens. This is about protecting the integrity of the ballot box, national sovereignty, and ensuring that our sacred civic duties are reserved for those who actually belong to our national family. Of course, the progressive elites and open-border ideologues are bound to cry foul, but this measure only applies to state elections and only impacts new registrants. It’s a modest, responsible step toward restoring order and accountability, and every state in the Union should follow South Dakota's lead in putting citizens first.
